name: Butler
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Butler, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Butler, Pennsylvania for 2026: Santa visits, parades and lights, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Butler County's season starts the weekend after Thanksgiving with parades on Main Street in Butler and Saxonburg, and Kittanning follows with a parade and a Festival of Trees.
celebrates: Butler is the Butler County seat, and its Main Street hosts the Butler Spirit of Christmas Parade, presented by Butler Radio Network according to the county tourism bureau. Saxonburg holds its own parade the night before and welcomes Santa and the Grinch on Saturday. Kittanning, the Armstrong County seat, holds a Christmas parade with floats, trucks and Santa and keeps a Festival of Trees on display at Riverfront Park well into January.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for these parades, so this page uses each host's 2026 listing. The county tourism bureau lists the Butler and Saxonburg parades as annual events, and the Kittanning host describes its Festival of Trees as a yearly display.
facts: Visit Butler County lists the Butler parade at 5:30 pm on Main Street and the Saxonburg parade on Main Street the evening before. Kittanning's parade entries line up on Market Street at 5 pm. The Festival of Trees at Riverfront Park closed tree orders on November 2 and stays up through January 10, 2027, which makes it one of the longest running displays in the region.
trains: We did not find a holiday train ride in Butler for 2026. The nearest train events for families are the Beaver County Model Railroad open house in Monaca and the Pittsburgh area events on our Pittsburgh page.
traditions: Butler Radio Network's Main Street parade on November 28.
A Friday night parade on Saxonburg's Main Street, November 27.
Floats, trucks and Santa on December 4.
Decorated trees at Kittanning Riverfront Park through January 10, 2027.
kidfact: Santa and the Grinch both visit Saxonburg's Main Street the weekend after Thanksgiving.
faq: Butler holds its Spirit of Christmas Parade on Main Street on November 28, Saxonburg holds a parade on November 27, and Kittanning holds a parade on December 4 plus a Festival of Trees at Riverfront Park through January 10, 2027.
Are the Butler County Christmas parades free?
Yes. All three parades are public street parades and watching is free.
When is the Butler Christmas parade in 2026?
The Butler Spirit of Christmas Parade is Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 5:30 pm on Main Street, according to Visit Butler County.
Is there a Festival of Trees near Butler?
Yes. The Festival of Trees at Kittanning Riverfront Park stays on display through January 10, 2027.
sources: Kittanning Holiday Parade and Festival of Trees
intro_html:
